summary: A fresh non-author reviewer completed the five-axis final review and found no unresolved Critical or Required finding. The bounded local write-producing DAG, current executable evidence ledger, preservation checks, and claim boundaries are coherent and independently reproducible.

claims.claim: Specification axis passes within the documented bounded scope.
evidence: All approved pre-final success criteria are satisfied; root-owned review receipt, final validation receipt, and integrity manifest were the only expected post-review outputs.
Materializer suite passed 5/5; named-run suite passed 13/13; schema, generator, server, client, and fail-closed compatibility behavior agree.

All 97 pre-final v0.2 JSON files parsed; 10 executable current TaskContracts were conformant and byte-identical to immutable revisions; dependencies, routes, dispositions, scopes, locks, and T8 r4/r5 cancellations reconcile.

v0.1 archive 25/25 and snapshot 7/7; both fingerprints reproduced; only live references/task-contract.md differs under ADR-0003 and ADR-0004; 86 fixture files including nested Git metadata had zero before/after test deltas.

claims.claim: Evidence and claim-boundary axis passes with bounded caveats.
evidence: T8 revision 3 Required findings R1-R3 are closed; 19 exact revisions and 11 explicitly unavailable early bodies reconcile; tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md accurately represented the pre-final state.

advisory_findings.title: Partial materializer failure recovery
advisory_findings.detail: A Git failure after copytree can leave a partial non-overwritable run; future hardening may stage and atomically promote or document cleanup.

advisory_findings.title: Historical replay boundary
advisory_findings.detail: Eleven early overwritten TaskContract bodies remain explicitly unavailable and support bounded lifecycle claims only.

advisory_findings.title: Parallel timing evidence
advisory_findings.detail: Evidence proves eligibility and parallel dispatch of disjoint writers, not a performance or physical-simultaneity guarantee.

advisory_findings.title: Validation breadth
advisory_findings.detail: No third-party OpenAPI validator, production workload, persistent scheduler, or cross-machine run was exercised.

advisory_findings.title: Preflight record convention
advisory_findings.detail: Evidence consumers must honor record_kind and not treat every contracts/*.json file as dispatchable.

uncertainty: The exact inherited root model and effort are not runtime-attested.
Git emitted non-failing LF-to-CRLF warnings; future Git writes on Windows could alter line endings.
The result validates one bounded local nested-Git software-development fixture, not a production orchestrator.
